Extracts JSON-LD structured data from a page

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.json_ld)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.json_ld, 0).schema_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.json_ld, 0).name)
```
